sweep_overrides._reason: T134 roar on the balls of the feet: foot_roll +24 lifts the ankles about 60 mm, so the COG can rise above the flat-foot +0.01 limit (manifest: '+0.01 = legs already straight at rest'); ik_ratio stays <= 0.97.

poses.name: ready
poses.intent: = attack_swing f1 = idle f1 exactly (CTRL / PROPS copied from idle.json poses[frame 1], mouth_open 0): ready stance, club upright beside the right hip, free arm hanging. Loop pose (f39 = f1).

poses.name: windup
poses.intent: Wind-up / gather (reference f5-8, lowest f7: head top -111 mm, belt -102 mm squash, arms drawn in, club tilted out/down). COG limited while planted, so the lower body copies hit f8 (CTRL_torso loc Y -0.036 = 21 mm below ready, pelvis X 8 against knee/calf creases) and the crouch is shown with the upper body: forward curl spine_01 X 10 + chest X 12, head pitched down 16, shoulders hunched (left Z 20, right Z -24.5 = C2 boundary margin), left arm drawn in (upper arm -52 / X -12, elbow 55), right upper arm lowered to 50 (55 opened a visible armpit crease, cover >=2) and right hand FK 39.2 / 70.2 / 9.8 so the club tilts outward and down (front tilt about -14 deg vs -8 at f1; DEF wrist bend 30.1). Mouth closed (mouth_open 0). No scale.

poses.name: roar
poses.intent: Roar peak (reference f10-26, peak from f11): burst up - body rises onto the balls of the feet (T134, user 2026-09-26: CTRL_torso loc Y +0.048 = 63 mm above ready (sweep_overrides widens loc Y to +0.08; the heel lift raises the ankles), loc Z +0.04 forward so the hips stay over the ankles that the heel lift moves forward (hip_flex under 60, no hip / knee crease), leg ik_ratio 0.955 / 0.961), chest lifted with a back bend spine_01 X -5 + chest X -6, head tilted up -16, mouth_open 1 (the shape key stretches the head up; open mouth unobstructed in the front view). Left arm flung up and out (shoulder Z 24.5, upper arm Z 7 / X -10, elbow 15; reference fist +570 mm up, +96 mm out). Right arm raises the club beside the head (shoulder X -10 / Z -24.5, upper arm 7.7 / 31.1 / 20, elbow 36.8, hand FK -16.5 / 42.1 / -12.1; club leans in toward the head about 19 deg like the reference, fist beside the head, upper arm raise well under 100). Feet (T134, reference f10-14 / feet_sheet.png): heels up on the balls (foot_roll_l / r +24 = heel up about the toe pivot, clamps l [-24, 26], r [-27, 29]; from +22 the single ball contact is shoe vertex l 3776 / r 3940) and splayed out about the toe (toe_twist_l +15 / toe_twist_r -15, clamps l [-16, 21], r [-20, 15]; heel_twist 0); CTRL_foot_ik_l loc (0.00456, 0.01155, 0) / _r (-0.00011, 0.01268, 0) keep that ball vertex at its ready-pose ground XY (pivot contact, no slide). No scale.
